title: Peripheral B cells, ACPA-positive non-converter, pre, scRNA-seq, PN5A
treatment_protocol_ch1: No experimental treatment was applied. Samples are paired longitudinal peripheral blood draws (pre and post) from healthy controls, ACPA-positive non-converters, and ACPA-positive individuals who converted to clinical rheumatoid arthritis.
growth_protocol_ch1: Not applicable (ex vivo peripheral blood B cells; no cell culture growth protocol).
extract_protocol_ch1: Peripheral blood was collected and B cells were enriched for single-cell multiomics profiling. Gene expression, surface protein (ADT), and BCR V(D)J libraries were prepared using 10x Genomics Chromium workflows according to the manufacturer protocols.
Single-cell gene expression, CITE-seq/ADT, and BCR V(D)J libraries were constructed with the 10x Genomics Chromium platform and sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq X Plus instrument.
description: Library name: PN5A_GEX
10x Genomics Chromium gene expression library; Cell Ranger filtered feature-barcode matrix
data_processing: GEX FASTQ files were processed with 10x Genomics Cell Ranger to generate filtered feature-barcode count matrices (barcodes.tsv.gz, features.tsv.gz, matrix.mtx.gz) aligned to the human GRCh38 reference transcriptome.

CITE-seq/ADT libraries were processed to UMI count matrices (barcodes.tsv.gz, features.tsv.gz, matrix.mtx.gz) for antibody-derived tags; antibody feature definitions are provided in feature_README.txt.
BCR V(D)J FASTQ files were processed with 10x Genomics Cell Ranger VDJ to generate filtered contig FASTA and filtered_contig_annotations.csv files.
Processed files were assigned unique sample-specific filenames for GEO deposition while retaining Cell Ranger file contents.
Assembly: GRCh38

Supplementary files format and content: For each GEX sample: Cell Ranger filtered feature-barcode matrix Market Exchange (MEX) files (*_GEX_barcodes.tsv.gz, *_GEX_features.tsv.gz, *_GEX_matrix.mtx.gz) containing UMI counts for gene expression features. For each CITE-seq sample: ADT UMI count MEX files (*_CITE_barcodes.tsv.gz, *_CITE_features.tsv.gz, *_CITE_matrix.mtx.gz). For each BCR sample: Cell Ranger filtered_contig_annotations.csv and filtered_contig.fasta. Supplementary feature_README.txt maps ADT barcodes to antibody names.

Supplementary files format and content: Matrix Market files store sparse cell-by-feature UMI counts; features are Ensembl gene IDs (GEX) or antibody-derived tags (CITE). BCR annotation CSV includes contig-level V(D)J calls and cell barcodes.
